:::{#exr-ci-diff-means}

Given
a [maximum likelihood estimate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) $\evb$
and
a corresponding estimated [covariance matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-cov-vec-x)
$\eS \eqdef \widehat{\Covt}(\evb)$,
calculate a 95% [confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-confidence-interval) for the difference in means
comparing covariate patterns $\vx$ and $\vxs$:

$$\Delta \mu \eqdef \mu(\vx) - \mu(\vxs)$$

:::
